source.title: Some Open Problems in Decidability of Brick (Labelled Polyomino) Codes

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document identifier 2176114. zbMATH API metadata identified the exact work as a 2004 LNCS chapter by Malgorzata Moczurad and Wlodzimierz Moczurad, DOI 10.1007/978-3-540-27798-9_10.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted. The DOI resolved to a Springer chapter page that exposed only citation metadata, references, an abstract, and purchase or institutional-login options, not full chapter text. Crossref confirmed a Springer PDF candidate for the same DOI, but the available local fetch could not resolve the Springer PDF host. OpenAlex confirmed the same DOI and title but reported open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, best_oa_location=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched by exact title, DOI, and DBLP record. DBLP and Springer book pages were resolver or table-of-contents pages. Exact-title search exposed a possible proceedings PDF mirror and other pages that cited the chapter, but the mirror could not be opened or downloaded with the available tools, and citation pages, abstracts, and search snippets were rejected as extraction sources.
No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the chapter's technical problem statements was recovered, so document mapping and candidate extraction were not performed.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/2176114.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
